13.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
Thereafter the complainant de facto was induced to join another group on the Telegram App where he was made to deposit Rs.3,51,470/- in the name of online prepaid tasks by some unknown telegram users.
In the course of investigation,
four bank accounts were traced out as beneficiaries and those accounts were in the name of a proprietorship concern of co-accused Golu.
